title: Learning a Whole-Body Pivot-Walking Gait for Heavy-Box Transport with a Humanoid
abstract: arXiv:2611.33828v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Through pivot walking, humans can transport objects that are too heavy to lift. Previous humanoid studies have relied on planned sequences in which object manipulation and stepping are executed separately and the object is brought to rest between successive rotations. However, few studies have developed a single learned controller for humanoid pivot walking. In this paper, we propose a single reinforcement-learning policy that jointly coordinates stepping, balance control, and object manipulation. The policy is trained using rewards that promote alternating pivot motions and a phase reference that progresses according to the displacement of the object. In simulation, we confirmed that the humanoid can pivot a box. For deployment, we fine-tuned the policy into an object-blind version that follows a periodic clock instead of the progress reference. On the real robot, the deployed policy transported the box forward by more than 1 m in all

translated_title: 面向人形机器人重箱搬运的全身枢轴行走步态学习
translated_abstract: 通过枢轴行走，人类可以搬运那些重到无法直接举起的物体。以往的人形机器人研究依赖于规划好的动作序列，其中物体操作和迈步是分开执行的，并且在连续旋转之间物体需要被停稳。然而，很少有研究为人形机器人的枢轴行走开发出单一的学习型控制器。本文提出了一种单一的强化学习策略，该策略联合协调迈步、平衡控制和物体操作。该策略通过鼓励交替枢轴运动的奖励，以及根据物体位移推进的相位参考进行训练。在仿真中，我们验证了人形机器人能够枢转箱子。为了部署到实际硬件上，我们将策略微调为不依赖物体信息的版本，该版本遵循周期性时钟信号而非进度参考。在真实机器人上，所部署的策略在所有实验中都将箱子向前搬运了超过1米。
tldr: 本文提出单一强化学习策略联合协调人形机器人的迈步、平衡控制与物体操作，实现枢轴行走搬运重箱，并在真实机器人上成功将箱子向前搬运超过1米。
en_tdlr: A single reinforcement-learning policy jointly coordinates stepping, balance control, and object manipulation, enabling a humanoid to pivot-walk and transport a heavy box over 1 m on a real robot.
